title: The Delver's Pick
blurb: An old miner's pick waits in the stone of an adit. It hums at metal and wakes a little more each time you use it well.

steps.text: Pull the Delver's Pick from the stone at the end of an old adit.
steps.hint: An adit is a timbered tunnel into a hillside. With no adit near your home, your Hearth keeps a pick for you.

steps.text: Break a lode's heart with the pick on you.
steps.hint: Hold the pick and it hums when its head points at metal. Follow the hum to a lode and mine into its middle.

steps.text: Light a dead Delver lamp with the pick on you.
steps.hint: Delver lamps hang on chains from cave roofs. Hit one with any pickaxe and it lights the hall round it.

steps.text: Bring the pick and 3 diamonds to your Forge.
steps.hint: Use the Forge with the pick in your hand. Tempered, it can cut Deepglass.

steps.text: Cut Deepglass with the pick on you.
steps.hint: Deepglass grows in seeps, violet halls below y 0. A Tuning Fork tuned to Deepglass points the way.

steps.text: Quiet a seep by killing its heart, with the pick on you.
steps.hint: The seep heart is rooted near the Deepglass. While a seep lives, the creatures in it are five levels stronger.

steps.text: Bring the pick and a starmetal ingot to your Forge.
steps.hint: Starmetal comes from fallen stars. Smelt the raw starmetal into an ingot.

finish.line: The Delver's Pick is fully awake.
